How to Dockerize an AI chatbot (the right way) 🐳

Last time it broke on a clean machine. Now it runs anywhere with Docker:
✅ slim, pinned base image (python:3.12.7-slim)
✅ dependencies declared with exact versions (requirements.txt)
✅ only the code goes in (.dockerignore keeps .env out)
✅ runs as a normal user, not root
✅ the API key comes in at runtime, never inside the image

Docker isn't really about containers. It's about trust: what you tested is exactly what runs.

Follow to see this chatbot reach production 🚀

#docker #python #genai #devops #ai
yt_title: How to Dockerize a Python AI chatbot the right way #docker
yt_description:
Dockerizing a small Python AI chatbot (LLM call stubbed for the demo, fake key):
- FROM python:3.12.7-slim (pinned)
- requirements.txt with exact versions
- COPY only the code; .dockerignore keeps .env out
- USER nobody (not root)
- API key passed at runtime with --env-file
Proof: ls -a in the image shows no .env; whoami prints nobody.

Part of the "AI App to Production" journey: one AI chatbot from laptop to production. Follow along.
